snippet.title: Scarcity has muscle memory. Especially if you grew up without a lot of money.
snippet.description:
You feel a tightening, a contraction, that flinch of fear right when you spend. “What if I run out? What if there won’t be enough?”

Most of the money mindset rewiring that gets you to your next financial breakthrough happens in your BODY.

Teach your nervous system it's safe to spend, safe to receive, safe to hold more. Next time you feel the contraction of scarcity, take a deep breath. Get present to the miracle of YOU – that you made it through all that and you’re alive today.

Abundance feels like expansion. 💛“What I spend will always be replaced by more.” Because literally, when has it not?

Notice it next time you spend — expansion or contraction?

It’s not whether you have conflict that determines if your relationship lasts.

-The 4 most common behaviors in every relationship that drive people apart

-One 10-minute Sunday habit that makes you both feel like you’re on the same team
-“Turning away” vs. “turning against” - the tiny moments that make your partner feel loved… or alone

If you’re feeling like you and your partner have become roommates who barely see each other, you’re not alone. Nobody taught you how to do this. And even if you had great role models, marriage comes with challenges no one can fully prepare you for.

So let this episode be your wake-up call – and the way back to each other.
